finalText:
Build is clean now. The warnings you're seeing are deprecation notices from the package bump itself — that's just noise.

The two real bugs were in the link stage. Your new bundler changed how it passes options, and the old code didn't keep up:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — was reading `options.retries` but the new bundler sends `options.retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — was throwing when the flag was undefined, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as undefined instead of false.

Both files are fixed. Build finishes in 44.9s with zero errors now.
